lines.ei_line: If that sounded strange, it's understandable — on Earth, adult height feels like one of the few things that never changes.

lines.ei_line: Food is one of the comforts people miss most far from home, so this one can feel a little disappointing.
lines.neutral_line: This point belongs to the nutrition section of the crew training program for long missions.

lines.ei_line: Reading about your body changing shape can feel a bit unsettling, and that's a very normal reaction.

lines.ei_line: If you feel a spark of curiosity here, hold on to it — flames in orbit are one of the strangest sights in space.

lines.ei_line: Crying far from home is something many people can relate to, so this detail may feel more personal than the others.

lines.ei_line: There's something quietly beautiful about this one, and it's fine to simply enjoy it.

start.ei: Hi, I'm Nova. Starting something new can feel exciting and a little nerve-wracking at the same time, and both are completely normal. I'll be with you the whole way.
